subject: Hon Dolo push to D: Falcon 802, Story Set 02 393, Enablers 03 604 (preliminary)
body:
Hon Dolo drafts on the box were pushed to D:\Documents\CFA\docs\notes\downloads\ on 2026-10-12. Only new files were merged in: existing folders and NOTES.md files from other bots were not overwritten, and every version was kept. The one exception is Falcon C26-C40, where the 22-per-category set on the box replaced the older copies with Ziggy's approval.

- GROK-HD-FALCON-1000: 802 images (884 files). C01-C25 have 15 each (C04 has 17), C26-C40 have 22 each, C41-C46 have 15 each and C47 has 5.
  MANIFEST.csv SHA-256: 0288ee8fdea7260c01202edf9fa46da582e8546bbd0e57b581c442a81ccd3e48
- GROK-HD-STORY-SET-02: 393 images (438 files). N01-N26 have 15 each and N27 has 3.
  MANIFEST.csv SHA-256: 1c492c275cd4706ee6da5edbcb2aa169080db5fa6feefe6949850bceb7de4679
- GROK-HD-ENABLERS-03: 604 images (669 files), a new archive. It covers E01 (9 so far), E12-E47 and E49-E50.
  MANIFEST.csv SHA-256: 04ee224be0f7dd237d094f8096ca07232f90474f8474e6ad9ed0eaf187e1c871

Each archive root now has a rebuilt MANIFEST.csv (path, bytes, sha256) and SHORTLIST.md, which holds up to 5 picks per category scored L4 S4 or better.
Spot check: 24 random images (8 per archive) were re-hashed on D: and all of them match the box sources.

Everything is preliminary: self-scored drafts only, with no song timestamps. Nothing is accepted until Nova intake or Ziggy accepts it.
Still missing: E02-E11 (Dolo identity packs), E48 (lighting keys), N28-N32, and Falcon C60 and above (to follow in a later push).
